versions.title: Track System Updates and Versions

newFeatures.text: Added a version monitoring system so users can see the latest updates for each system
Users can now view update history including old versions
Centralized the version monitoring data using GitHub so all LGU systems use one shared JSON file instead of separate copies

improvements: Made it easier for users to see what changes were made in each update
Improved tracking of system updates so users can understand changes over time
Improved maintainability by using a single centralized JSON source, so updates automatically reflect across all LGU systems

versions.title: Digital Miscellaneous Issuance and Timestamp Monitoring
newFeatures: Added Digital Cedula in the issuance process
Added timestamp tracking feature for monitoring transaction processing flow
Created dynamic yearly DOC_TRACK[CurrentYear] tables in the Timestamp Database for organized transaction logging
improvements: Improved issuance process by supporting Digital Cedula for faster and more convenient transactions
Enhanced transaction monitoring by recording processing timestamps and workflow activities
Improved audit trail management by storing all timestamp transaction data in dedicated yearly DOC_TRACK tables

versions.title: UI Enhancements and Multi-Account Code Support
improvements: Updated the UI design with a more formal look and simpler, less colorful layout
Improved system to properly process multiple account codes when needed
fixes: Fixed query to handle multiple account codes instead of only one

versions.title: Initial Release of Miscellaneous System
newFeatures: Implemented the Miscellaneous System inside the WSP platform, accessible after user login
Added a dedicated Miscellaneous page for taxpayers
Introduced selectable miscellaneous certificates/services for payment
Added service descriptions and automatic total amount computation
Enabled users to proceed directly to payment from the Miscellaneous module
Integrated SPIDC Universal Checkout payment system
Enabled automatic generation of receipt / EOR (Electronic Official Receipt) after successful payment
improvements: Streamlined navigation from WSP system to Miscellaneous module for faster access
Improved user payment flow with a direct checkout process (reduced steps)
Enhanced clarity of service selection through structured descriptions and pricing display
Improved system integration between Miscellaneous module and SPIDC payment gateway
